annotations.title: Check a team against the most-used Pokémon

description: Check a team against the Pokémon it is most likely to face in a regulation. For each threat (the most used Pokémon by default, or the ones named) it reports the team's hardest hit into it, its hardest hit into the team, and which team members outspeed it. Each threat uses its most common set in the regulation's usage statistics. Results are single hits with no screens or stat changes, under the weather or terrain the attacker's own ability sets if any. This is not a battle simulation; use calculate_damage to examine one matchup under specific conditions.

format.description: Regulation id from list_formats. Defaults to "champions-regmc" (Pokémon Champions — Regulation M-C).

limit.description: How many of the most used Pokémon to check (1–10). Defaults to 8

team.description: The team, one to six Pokémon

ability.description: Ability. Defaults to the Pokémon's most used ability in the regulation.

boosts.description: Stat stages from moves and abilities, -6 to +6. For example { atk: 2 }.

item.description: Held item, or "none". Defaults to the Pokémon's most used item in the regulation.

moves.description: This Pokémon's moves. Defaults to its most used attacks in the regulation.

nature.description: Nature, such as Adamant or Timid. If nature and statPoints are both left out, the Pokémon's most common spread in the regulation's usage statistics is used.

pokemon.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"

statPoints.description: Pokémon Champions stat points per stat (0–32 each, 66 in total). Stats left out get 0.

status.description: Burn halves physical damage dealt; paralysis halves Speed.

threats.description: Pokémon to check against. Defaults to the most used in the regulation.

items.description: Pokémon name in English. Mega Evolutions are tracked separately, e.g. "Charizard-Mega-Y"

name: check_team_threats

assumptions.description: Everything the calculation assumed, including any part of a set that was filled in because it was not given. Tell the user about these.

format.description: Regulation id the result applies to

conditions.description: Weather or terrain set by the attacker's own ability, when applied

maxPercent.description: Highest damage roll as % of the defender's HP

minPercent.description: Lowest damage roll as % of the defender's HP

bestAnswer.description: The team's hardest hit into the threat

conditions.description: Weather or terrain set by the attacker's own ability, when applied

maxPercent.description: Highest damage roll as % of the defender's HP

minPercent.description: Lowest damage roll as % of the defender's HP

biggestRisk.description: The threat's hardest hit into the team

set.description: Nature and stat points used for the threat

title: Check a team against the most-used Pokémon
